justification: Both surfaces include a highly schematic human-derived form and a round disc motif, but in A the human is a tiny stick figure with raised arms beside a long horizontal serpentine line and a small isolated dot, while B is a monolithic frontal/rear-view figure with head and body whose surface bears low-relief concentric rings, arcs and curved bands. The relationships and layout differ entirely: A is a linear two-element scene on a flat panel, B is a single sculptural body carrying an arrangement of symmetrical carved motifs on its back and shoulders.
